transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and empty inside for about six months now. It just isn't getting any better, and I realized I couldn't keep going on like this. That's why I finally decided to come in.
During these past six months, have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or impulsive, to the point where you needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't felt energetic or talkative at all, and I certainly haven't had a decreased need for sleep. In fact, it's been the complete opposite where I just feel incredibly low and constantly tired.

Beyond feeling sad and tired, have you been experiencing other symptoms like significant changes in your appetite, difficulty concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, or a loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in all my hobbies, and I can't even focus enough to watch TV or read anymore. I feel completely worthless and useless, and my appetite has just totally disappeared lately.
Have you felt this way every single day for the past six months, or have there been periods of a few weeks or more where you felt like your normal self?

Yes, I've felt this way every single day without any break at all. There haven't been any periods where I felt like my normal self. It's just been a constant, heavy gloom and a total lack of energy for the entire six months.
Since these symptoms started, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or have you made any plans to harm yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel completely empty and worthless, I've never thought about suicide or making any plans like that.
Have you experienced these feelings of sadness, low energy, and worthlessness at any point in your life before this current six-month period, perhaps during your childhood or teenage years?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before. This is the first time in my life I've felt this way, even looking back at when I was younger.
